name: Hack-A-Ton
tagline: A typing game where you play the hacker and learn that strong passwords are the hardest to type in time.
problem: Password lessons are explicit and easy to ignore.
solution: Waves of users approach; players type their passwords to win, so long, mixed passwords become memorable through difficulty.
demo_moment: Team-described: race to type weak and strong passwords as enemies close in.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Teaches implicitly by flipping the player onto the attacker's side.
All three members were first-time Lua developers.

lessons: Put the player in the attacker's seat and the lesson teaches itself.
